The '''Vaynai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Chorlian sector/Legends|Chorlian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]].
